run_vrs_data_provider_demo: run the TestBindings CLI with a VRS file path to demo all Project Aria data provider bindings
create_vrs_data_provider: create a VRS data provider from a file path using data_provider.create_vrs_data_provider
get_device_calibration: get device calibration data including camera intrinsics, extrinsics, IMU, and ET sensor calibrations
access_sensor_data_sequentially: access sensor data sequentially using deliver_queued_sensor_data with stream activation and subsampling options
random_access_image_data: random access image data by index or timestamp using get_image_data_by_index and get_image_data_by_time_ns
